linear_regression.name: Ambient Temperature vs. Cooling Power
linear_regression.context: Hostel chiller electricity demand across varying seasonal temperatures in Gujarat.
linear_regression.learning_objective: Observe a strong positive linear correlation (R² ≈ 0.90) and derive the rate of power increase per degree Celsius (β₁ ≈ 3.8).

linear_regression.name: Study Hours vs. Examination Score
linear_regression.context: Student performance in an AI introductory course relative to preparation time.
linear_regression.learning_objective: Examine how individual variation introduces residuals even with a clear general upward trend.
linear_regression.expected_behavior: Clear upward trend with moderate residual dispersion around the regression line.

linear_regression.name: Hostel Headcount vs. Energy Consumption
linear_regression.context: Daily electricity consumption scaled by the number of students staying in Block A.
linear_regression.learning_objective: Understand the intercept β₀ as baseline standby/facility energy when occupancy approaches zero.
linear_regression.expected_behavior: Positive slope showing per-capita energy increment; intercept indicates building base-load.

linear_regression.name: Awareness Campaign Budget vs. Conservation Compliance
linear_regression.context: Investment in student energy-saving campaigns and the resulting percentage compliance.
linear_regression.learning_objective: Analyze small coefficient values resulting from large scale differences between X (thousands) and Y (percentages).
linear_regression.expected_behavior: Small positive slope coefficient highlighting the importance of unit interpretation.

linear_regression.name: Wing Floor Area vs. Base Power Demand
linear_regression.context: Architectural floor space across campus dormitories and their passive electrical base-load.
linear_regression.learning_objective: Observe continuous architectural scaling and how physical spatial dimensions predict base power.
linear_regression.expected_behavior: Consistent positive regression slope with uniform variance along the domain.

linear_regression.name: Heating Degree Days vs. Thermal Energy
linear_regression.context: Himalayan hostel winter heating demand as a function of thermal deficit below 18°C.
linear_regression.learning_objective: Model heating energy demand directly from building physics heating-degree-day theory.
linear_regression.expected_behavior: Strong correlation; intercept represents baseline water heater consumption on zero HDD days.

linear_regression.name: Kitchen Operating Hours vs. Energy Use
linear_regression.context: Hostel mess kitchen ovens, refrigeration, and steamers running daily schedules.
linear_regression.learning_objective: Verify how equipment runtime provides a nearly direct physical coefficient reflecting power rating.
linear_regression.expected_behavior: High R² (> 0.92); slope reflects average combined kilowatt rating of operational appliances.

linear_regression.name: Solar PV Output vs. Grid Import (Negative Slope)
linear_regression.context: Displacement of grid utility power by on-site rooftop solar photovoltaic generation.
linear_regression.learning_objective: Explore an inverse (negative) linear slope (β₁ ≈ -0.92) and its physical interpretation.
linear_regression.expected_behavior: Negative regression slope demonstrating demand offset through renewable self-generation.

linear_regression.name: Multivariate Hostel Energy Predictors
linear_regression.context: Simultaneous regression on temperature, occupancy count, and air conditioner operational hours.
linear_regression.learning_objective: Observe multiple regression where individual standardized coefficients indicate relative feature leverage.
linear_regression.expected_behavior: High overall explained variance; AC hours and temperature dominate the standardized β weights.

linear_regression.name: Noisy Telemetry with Severe Outliers
linear_regression.context: Water heating telemetry containing faulty sensor surges and zero-reading transmission dropouts.
linear_regression.learning_objective: Discover how Ordinary Least Squares squared residuals (e²) make the fitted line vulnerable to extreme outliers.
linear_regression.expected_behavior: The fitted slope tilts noticeably toward outliers; residual plot shows extreme leverage points.

decision_tree.name: Hostel Energy Consumption Regime (Binary Classification)
decision_tree.context: Classifying whether a hostel wing enters a peak demand surge based on ambient heat and student presence.
decision_tree.learning_objective: See how a Decision Tree identifies orthogonal rectangular decision boundaries in feature space.
decision_tree.expected_behavior: Root split isolates high temperatures, secondary split partitions occupancy ratio.

decision_tree.name: Wing Crowding Status (Multi-Class Classification)
decision_tree.context: Categorizing hostel commons into Vacant, Normal, or Crowded based on gateway sensors.
decision_tree.learning_objective: Understand multi-class Gini impurity and how decision splits segregate multiple class labels.
decision_tree.expected_behavior: Tree forms hierarchical thresholds dividing three operational status regions.

decision_tree.name: Cooling Appliance Mode Selection
decision_tree.context: Predicting student cooling method choice based on temperature and heat index humidity.
decision_tree.learning_objective: Learn how feature interactions (e.g. temperature combined with high humidity) trigger branch paths.
decision_tree.expected_behavior: Primary split on temperature, followed by a humidity split on intermediate temperatures.

decision_tree.name: Hostel Building Envelope Efficiency Grade
decision_tree.context: Architectural envelope ratings across campus accommodation blocks.
decision_tree.learning_objective: Observe how physical threshold standards map naturally to decision tree branches.
decision_tree.expected_behavior: Clean decision boundaries separating building efficiency tiers.

decision_tree.name: Non-Linear Peak Demand (Regression Tree)
decision_tree.context: Continuous electrical demand displaying discontinuous schedule jumps throughout the day.
decision_tree.learning_objective: Understand how DecisionTreeRegressor approximates non-linear step functions through constant leaf predictions.
decision_tree.expected_behavior: First split isolates evening peak hours [18, 23], predicting higher mean kilowatt values.

decision_tree.name: Time-of-Day Electricity Tariff Tier
decision_tree.context: DISCOM utility billing classification determining hourly electricity costs.
decision_tree.learning_objective: See how tree splits model regulatory utility pricing rules accurately.
decision_tree.expected_behavior: Clock hour splits isolate night off-peak and morning/evening peak intervals.

decision_tree.name: Hostel Wing Structural Architecture
decision_tree.context: Classification of dormitory buildings into High-Rise vs Low-Rise configurations.
decision_tree.learning_objective: Observe high feature importance on a deterministic divider (floor count) versus supporting features.
decision_tree.expected_behavior: Floor count achieves 100% Gini reduction in a single root split.

decision_tree.name: Weather-Based HVAC Dispatch Command
decision_tree.context: Automated building management decision rule for chiller and ventilation dispatch.
decision_tree.learning_objective: Understand how operational engineering heuristics are translated into binary tree conditions.
decision_tree.expected_behavior: Temperature splits separate economizer mode from active chilling; solar radiation refines pre-cooling.

decision_tree.name: Academic Schedule & Thermal Concurrency
decision_tree.context: Predicting critical load peaks during student exam weeks under variable temperatures.
decision_tree.learning_objective: See decision trees effortlessly handle binary flags (exam week) alongside continuous physical metrics.
decision_tree.expected_behavior: Binary feature creates an immediate branch partition isolating exam week behaviors.

decision_tree.name: Overfitting vs. Pruning Demonstration
decision_tree.context: Noisy sensor readings designed to illustrate leaf memorization versus generalized shallow trees.
decision_tree.learning_objective: Understand how deep unconstrained trees create isolated single-sample leaves around noise points.
decision_tree.expected_behavior: Constraining max_depth=3 yields clean generalization; deep tree isolates noise with complex splits.

kmeans.name: Three Distinct Operational Regimes
kmeans.context: Hostel daily consumption cleanly separated into Night Standby, Daytime Active, and Evening Peak.
kmeans.learning_objective: Observe optimal cluster convergence on well-separated data (Silhouette Score > 0.70).
kmeans.expected_behavior: Elbow method shows sharp deflection at k=3; centroids align with the 3 operational modes.

kmeans.name: Temporal Lifestyle Regimes (Early vs Night)
kmeans.context: Diurnal electricity timing separating early morning risers from late-night studying habits.
kmeans.learning_objective: See how unlabelled data discovers behavioral archetypes without supervision.
kmeans.expected_behavior: Clear separation at k=2 with high silhouette coefficient.

kmeans.name: Building Energy Use Intensity (EUI) Benchmarking
kmeans.context: Normalised per-square-meter metrics across 150 campus facilities.
kmeans.learning_objective: Understand how clustering benchmarks facility energy efficiency across heterogeneous structures.
kmeans.expected_behavior: Evaluates 4 facility tiers with increasing annual EUI and peak density.

kmeans.name: Seasonal Cooling Operational Archetypes
kmeans.context: Hostel cooling response during temperate spring, scorching summer, and humid monsoon.
kmeans.learning_objective: Learn how feature standardisation is essential when variables have different scales (temp vs runtime).
kmeans.expected_behavior: Reveals 3 seasonal clusters reflecting ambient thermal drivers.

kmeans.name: Hostel Population & Thermal Water Demand
kmeans.context: Water geyser runtime linked to full weekday occupancy vs weekend departures and holidays.
kmeans.learning_objective: Observe how calendar schedules naturally create distinct physical demand clusters.
kmeans.expected_behavior: Centroids clearly identify Full Term, Weekend Lull, and Vacation Baseline.

kmeans.name: 3-Dimensional Appliance Signatures
kmeans.context: Sub-metered circuit breakdown across lighting, dining mess cooking, and central HVAC.
kmeans.learning_objective: Understand Euclidean distance calculation in 3-dimensional space (d = √(Δx² + Δy² + Δz²)).
kmeans.expected_behavior: Centroids isolate distinct circuit-specific operational dominance.

kmeans.name: Diurnal Peak Electrical Signatures
kmeans.context: Comparison of morning vs evening power spikes across regular and exam semester intervals.
kmeans.learning_objective: Discover how clustering clusters load shapes to guide peak shaving strategies.
kmeans.expected_behavior: Two distinct clusters separating balanced diurnal schedules from evening-dominated peaks.

kmeans.name: Multi-Dimensional Campus Facility Typologies
kmeans.context: Profiling university buildings across area, headcount, on-site solar, and grid import.
kmeans.learning_objective: See K-Means operate on 4-dimensional standardized vectors and interpret multidimensional centroids.
kmeans.expected_behavior: Unscaled centroids clearly characterize Modern Solar, Legacy Un-retrofitted, and High-Density Tower buildings.

kmeans.name: Unequal Cluster Sizes (Chiller Malfunction Anomaly)
kmeans.context: Detecting an infrequent but severe mechanical chiller malfunction cluster (13% of observations).
kmeans.learning_objective: Observe how K-Means partitions unbalanced cluster proportions and flags energy anomalies.
kmeans.expected_behavior: Centroid 2 captures the high-power failure mode despite comprising only 18 days.

kmeans.name: Overlapping Distributions & Cluster Ambiguity
kmeans.context: Transitional weather days where spring and early summer behaviors blend continuously.
kmeans.learning_objective: Explore lower silhouette scores (≈ 0.38) and how Euclidean Voronoi boundaries split overlapping continuous densities.
kmeans.expected_behavior: Centroids represent cluster averages, but boundary points have lower confidence.

pca.name: Collinear Sub-Meters (Strong Redundancy)
pca.context: Three sub-meters measuring adjacent interconnected hostel wings with synchronized schedules.
pca.learning_objective: Discover how PC1 captures > 95% of total variance when features are strongly collinear.
pca.expected_behavior: Scree plot shows PC1 dominating; loadings on PC1 are nearly equal across all three meters.

pca.name: Two Orthogonal Drivers: Weather vs. Occupancy
pca.context: Telemetry driven independently by outdoor thermal intensity and indoor resident headcount.
pca.learning_objective: Observe how PC1 and PC2 cleanly separate two independent physical drivers in the factor loadings matrix.
pca.expected_behavior: PC1 loads heavily on Temperature & AC; PC2 loads heavily on Headcount & Plug loads.

pca.name: Redundant Dual-Wing Environmental Sensors
pca.context: Paired IoT environmental sensors across North and South hostel corridors.
pca.learning_objective: Demonstrate dimensionality reduction compressing 4 correlated physical channels down to 2 principal components without losing information.
pca.expected_behavior: Cumulative variance of PC1 + PC2 exceeds 96%.

pca.name: Building Envelope Physics Profiles
pca.context: Architectural insulation properties across university campus residence halls.
pca.learning_objective: Understand how building thermal loss coefficients project onto dominant envelope quality axes.
pca.expected_behavior: PC1 represents overall thermal conductivity; PC2 reflects glazing proportion.

pca.name: Indoor Environmental Quality (IEQ) & Power Footprint
pca.context: Multi-modal room sensors recording CO2, noise levels, and plug loads driven by student presence.
pca.learning_objective: See how standardisation balances diverse physical units (ppm vs dB vs kW vs counts) before PCA.
pca.expected_behavior: Without standardisation, CO2 ppm (values 500-1100) would falsely overwhelm the variance; standardisation equalizes their influence.

pca.name: High-Dimensional Campus Energy Telemetry (8 Features)
pca.context: Comprehensive hostel telemetry spanning environmental, HVAC, lighting, kitchen, and elevators.
pca.learning_objective: Experience dimensionality reduction from 8 features down to 2 primary components explaining the majority of campus variance.
pca.expected_behavior: PC1 aligns with human activity loads; PC2 aligns with outdoor solar/cooling weather drivers.

pca.name: Single Dominant Variance Axis (>98% on PC1)
pca.context: Simulated parallel busbars reflecting a single master electrical generator load.
pca.learning_objective: Observe an extreme scree plot where PC1 accounts for > 98% of total variance, proving almost pure 1D redundancy.
pca.expected_behavior: Scree plot shows a massive first bar with near-zero subsequent eigenvalues.

pca.name: Planar 2-Component Subspace (Flat 3D Ellipsoid)
pca.context: Three-phase electrical generator currents mathematically constrained to a 2D plane.
pca.learning_objective: See a 3D point cloud collapse onto a 2D sheet, with PC1 and PC2 explaining ≈ 99.8% of variance.
pca.expected_behavior: PC3 eigenvalue is near zero; 2D projection preserves virtually 100% of the dataset geometry.

pca.name: Three Meaningful Independent Energy Components
pca.context: Facility subsystems capturing distinct Weather, Study, and Dining operational cycles.
pca.learning_objective: Interpret a scree plot where 3 components are required before the eigenvalue curve levels off (the elbow).
pca.expected_behavior: Scree plot shows 3 distinct elevated components; factor loadings show pairs of features matching each PC.

pca.name: Uncorrelated Spherical Noise (Information Loss Demonstration)
pca.context: Uncorrelated sensor noise testing the limits of dimensionality reduction.
pca.learning_objective: Discover what happens when PCA cannot reduce dimensions: explained variance is flat (≈ 25% per component), meaning reducing to 2D loses 50% of information.
pca.expected_behavior: Flat scree plot; each component explains ≈ 25% of variance, visually illustrating unavoidable information loss.
